title: Velkaris
description: The modpack used for the content smp "Velkaris".
body:

## Welcome to Velkaris!

Velkaris is a "Vanilla++" modpack that is primarily built around the Create Mod and it's addons. Fly to the moon with Create: Northstar, engage in wizzardry with Ars, hunt out forgotten items of immense power with Relics, or try and max your fishing journal, the choice is yours! There's something in this modpack for everyone.

For now at least, this modpack is unlisted so it can only be shared with Velkaris SMP member, in the future, this may change depending on public interest.

### Custom Mods:
The following custom mods are planned to be added after they are ported from Forge to NeoForge:
- Em's Easy End Lock
- Em's Server Utils
- Tablet of Experience 
- [Possibly] Relics of Dominion
